events.title: Every Breath You Take & Atomic-Oz
events.description: A live music showcase featuring The Police tribute act Every Breath You Take alongside Atomic-Oz, hosted at a local rehearsal and performance venue. Expect a high-energy evening of classic rock and tribute performances.

events.title: Charlie Ivan Band 'Of Nothing' Tour
events.description: The Charlie Ivan Band performs live as part of their 'Of Nothing' tour at the Mapleton Public House. This intimate venue setting offers a close-up experience with the band's latest musical material.

events.title: Deep Leech Live at The Presynct
events.description: Experimental or heavy music performance by Deep Leech held at Nambour's dedicated live music space, The Presynct. Known for fostering local alternative and grassroots music scenes.
